decision: For a skill documenting a library or CLI, a deterministic pass lists the installed package's public callables and CLI subcommands and reports each name the skill never mentions.

evidence.text: A full correctness audit passed a library skill whose package exported nine exception classes it never named; a probe then answered two questions about them with the wrong class. The shipped snippet was run on three stdlib packages and reported the counts.

reopen_if: audit_skills.py runs the completeness pass itself.
why: A correctness review only asks whether each statement is right, so a skill missing public names passes it and readers guess wrong about them.
